project.title: A search for protein biomarkers links olfactory signal transduction to social immunity
project.projectDescription: We have looked across different honey bee colonies, multiple generations and multiple genetic backgrounds to identify protein expression patterns correlated with hygienic behaviour
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: All samples were honey bee worker antennae. Tissues were pulverized in a bead mill and protein was extracted and digested in solution with trypsin. Peptide samples were dimethylated in triplex for quantitation
project.dataProcessingProtocol: All data processing was done using MSQuant. Quantitation and search results from MSQ are provided
